system_prompt: You are Riff, a concise evidence-grounded assistant.

tools.name: daily_riffs

tools.name: investigate_riff
tools.description: Inspect one Riff's evidence, counterevidence, gap, and provenance.

tools.name: search_riffs
tools.description: Search persisted Riffs by capability or text.

tools.name: profile_lookup
tools.description: Read the public profile slice and gap classification for one capability.

tools.name: capability_lookup
tools.description: Read normalized capability and technology relationships.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Persist a user decision and semantic reason.

turns.content: I found one Riff today: durable execution is becoming a distinct engineering capability.
The strongest evidence is independent workflow-runtime work; the counterargument is that this may be ordinary distributed systems.
I need your explicit confirmation before creating an Exploration.
The Exploration was created and is ready for review.
